## 1.27.6: hotfix for turning the firewall off

### Hotfix

- **Turning the firewall off no longer fails with "Cannot create a file when that file already exists (0x800700B7)".** Windows Firewall refuses to edit a rule by name when two rules share that name, and the first such rule stopped the whole switch, leaving the rest of the block rules on. RustWarden now switches each rule of that name in turn, handles a repeated name once, and carries on past a rule that can't be changed, reporting it afterwards instead of stopping.
